suggestedWeights.reason: Demonstrating understanding of the three distinct Salesforce Orgs (CAD/Telecom, E-Dockets, Pipeline Safety) and integration with MiLogin is crucial.
The client tightly scopes work to 600 hours annually across specific environments and mandates responding to all business specifications.
Standard hourly support and change notice processes are outlined without complex bespoke pricing models described in this section.
Adherence to release cycles, scheduled meetings, and a defined 5-year base term requires clear operational schedules.
The procurement document heavily emphasizes strict procedural and compliance responses over marketing language.
Business specification entries explicitly mandate identifying risks related to configurations, customizations, and hour allocations.
The State requires comprehensive disclosures across the Vendor Worksheet, standard terms affirmation, and each row of the Business Specifications.
